name: SearchForAlpha Lab
note: Free 7-day trial with your email. Prices and fundamentals frozen at the 11 Sep 2026 close; no broker, runs capped.
noteIt: Prova gratuita di 7 giorni con la tua email. Prezzi e fondamentali congelati alla chiusura dell’11 settembre 2026; nessun broker, esecuzioni limitate.

access.verification: 6-digit code plus a one-use link (confirm click, so mail scanners cannot spend it), 15 minutes
access.oneTrialPer: mailbox: lower-cased, +tags dropped, Gmail dots dropped; common throwaway domains refused
access.tracking: SQLite on the access-data volume: sign-ins, page loads, backtests, data and fundamentals loads, optimiser runs, limits hit, per email
access.admin: /admin, unlocked by DEMO_ADMIN_TOKEN (server .env); CSV export; extend, revoke, delete
access.privacy: Sign-in page states what is stored and why; deleted 365 days after the last visit or on request
access.mail: Neo mailbox of noeinsolutions.com (smtp0001.neo.space:465, implicit TLS), the same account and variable names as W3_capsar_io; SPF and DKIM already published for the domain; 200 sign-in emails a day at most, of Neo's ~1,000 shared by the mailbox
access.killSwitch: DEMO_ACCESS_GATE=false opens the demo to anyone, unrecorded; local runs only

data.bars: daily from 2006-01-03 (TSLA from 2010-06-29, META from 2012-05-18), 3,466 hourly bars per ticker; split- and dividend-adjusted, Yahoo Finance via yfinance
data.fundamentals: SEC EDGAR XBRL plus Yahoo analyst estimates, as of the snapshot close; none for SPY and QQQ (ETFs); XOM statements from the Yahoo fallback
data.refresh: python -m demo.freeze_demo_data --snapshot YYYY-MM-DD, run lib/tests/test_demo_mode.py, commit demo/fixtures/, update this file and docs/DEMO.md, bash deploy-demo.sh.

killSwitch.note: Unset or false and every page 404s (/healthz still answers 200 with demo:false); the dashboard is never imported, so it cannot fall back to the live, unguarded workspace. Default off.

disabled: Interactive Brokers connection, paper-trading agent and live mode: ib_async is not installed, lib/live/ is deleted from the image, and importing it is refused in-process
all outbound network except the one SMTP host:port that sends sign-in codes: other sockets to non-loopback hosts and yfinance are refused in-process
the options Flow Scanner (needs a live options chain)
writes to config/: presets and watchlists stay in the visitor's browser

limits.note: perIpPerHour counts optimiser runs started; perIpPerMinute counts backtests, data loads and fundamentals loads. Oversized requests are clamped server-side; refusals show a notice, never an error page. The date range is the snapshot's.

resets: Each visitor's dashboard state lives in memory and is dropped after 30 idle minutes (or when 60 visitors are held); optimiser studies are written to a tmpfs. Nothing a visitor does is visible to the next one. Only the access and usage log persists (access-data volume), and it is visible only at /admin.
costPerVisit: none beyond one email per sign-in from the Neo mailbox (capped at 60 an hour, 200 a day)
